test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Why has Utpal injured my pet dogs?

options.text: Why has my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?
Why have my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?
Why did been my pet dogs injured by Utpal?
Why had my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence. 
 
• The verb form **"have been injured"** is the correct passive construction for the present perfect tense.
 
• **"My pet dogs"** becomes the subject of the sentence in passive voice.
 
• **"By Utpal"** indicates the doer of the action and is placed after the verb in passive voice.
 
• Hence, the correct passive construction is** "have my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?"**

Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Why has my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?"** - This option does not use the correct verb form for passive voice. "Been" should be placed after "have" to form the correct present perfect passive construction.
 
• **Option 3: "Why did been my pet dogs injured by Utpal?" **- This option is grammatically incorrect. It mixes the present perfect tense ("have been") with the past tense ("did"), and the word order is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "Why had my pet dogs been injured by Utpal?" **- This option uses the past perfect tense ("had been injured"), which is not appropriate for the given sentence in present tense.
